# Permissions

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_permissions_doc.py from each package's policies.py and app/authz/role_templates.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Keys are `module.resource[.sub].action`. A grant has a scope: **Self** (records the person owns), **Team** (their direct and indirect reports), **Department** (their department and those under it) or **Organisation**. Records outside a person's scope answer 404. See ADR 0013.

## Catalogue

### attendance

| Key | Permission | Scopes | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `attendance.clock.use` | Clock in and out | Self |  | Clock in and out for yourself. |
| `attendance.correction.request` | Ask for attendance corrections | Self, Team, Department, Organisation |  | Ask to fix a day's clock-in and clock-out times (for yourself, or others in scope). |
| `attendance.photo.view` | See clock-in photos | Self, Team, Department, Organisation | yes | Open the photos taken when people clock in. |
| `attendance.record.approve` | Approve attendance | Self, Team, Department, Organisation |  | Decide correction requests and overtime within scope. |
| `attendance.record.read` | View attendance | Self, Team, Department, Organisation |  | See timesheets, who is in today and the monthly summary within scope. |
| `attendance.schedule.manage` | Manage shifts and rosters | Self, Team, Department, Organisation |  | Give people their usual shift and change single days on the roster. |
| `attendance.settings.manage` | Manage attendance settings | Organisation |  | Shift patterns and branch locations (geofence and photo). |

| Key | Permission | Scopes | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Role templates

Each installation starts with an editable copy of every template (Super Administrator excepted: it is protected). Business templates gain grants as their modules arrive. Scope letters: S self, T team, D department, O organisation.

## Separation of duties

| Rule | When performing | Blocked if | Message |
|---|---|---|---|
| `authz.no_self_assignment` | `authz.assignment.manage` | subject_is_actor | You can't change your own roles. Ask another administrator. |
| `leave.no_self_approval` | `leave.request.approve` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own leave. |
| `leave.no_self_hr_approval` | `leave.request.approve_hr` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own leave. |
| `leave.no_self_adjustment` | `leave.balance.adjust` | subject_is_actor | You can't adjust your own leave balance. |
| `attendance.no_self_approval` | `attendance.record.approve` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own attendance. |
| `expenses.no_self_approve` | `expenses.claim.approve` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own claim. |
| `expenses.no_self_approve_any` | `expenses.claim.approve_any` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own claim. |
| `expenses.no_self_approve_finance` | `expenses.claim.approve_finance` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own claim. |
| `expenses.no_self_reimburse` | `expenses.claim.reimburse` | owner_is_actor | You can't pay your own claim. |
| `payroll.no_self_pay_change` | `payroll.pay.manage` | subject_is_actor | You can't change your own pay. |
| `payroll.no_self_relief` | `payroll.relief.verify` | owner_is_actor | You can't verify your own rent declaration. |
| `payroll.no_self_loan` | `payroll.loan.approve` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own loan. |
| `payroll.loan_four_eyes` | `payroll.loan.approve` | creator_is_actor | Someone else approves a loan you recorded. |
| `finance.journal_four_eyes` | `finance.journal.post` | creator_is_actor | Someone else posts a journal you drafted. |
| `finance.credit_note_four_eyes` | `finance.credit_note.issue` | creator_is_actor | Someone else issues a credit note you drafted. |
| `finance.purchase_four_eyes` | `finance.purchase.approve` | creator_is_actor | Someone else approves a purchase order, bill or debit note you drafted. |
| `finance.payment_four_eyes` | `finance.payment.approve` | creator_is_actor | Someone else approves a supplier payment you prepared. |
| `finance.bank_four_eyes` | `finance.bank.approve` | creator_is_actor | Someone else approves a reconciliation or transfer you prepared. |
| `finance.asset_four_eyes` | `finance.asset.approve` | creator_is_actor | Someone else posts a depreciation run or approves an asset change you prepared. |
| `inventory.adjust_four_eyes` | `inventory.stock.approve` | creator_is_actor | Someone else posts a stock adjustment or count you recorded. |
| `inventory.no_self_approve` | `inventory.request.approve` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own material request. |
| `inventory.no_self_approve_any` | `inventory.request.approve_any` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own material request. |
| `procurement.no_self_approve` | `procurement.requisition.approve` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own requisition. |
| `procurement.no_self_approve_any` | `procurement.requisition.approve_any` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own requisition. |
| `procurement.no_self_approve_finance` | `procurement.requisition.approve_finance` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own requisition. |
| `procurement.no_self_approve_director` | `procurement.requisition.approve_director` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own requisition. |
| `projects.no_self_approve` | `projects.time.approve` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own time. |
| `projects.no_self_approve_any` | `projects.time.approve_any` | owner_is_actor | You can't approve your own time. |

Also enforced in app/authz/service.py: nobody can grant (to a role, a person or a delegate) a permission they don't hold themselves, or more widely than they hold it. Delegations last at most the configured number of days (default 90) and can't include `authz.*` or `system.*` permissions.
